banglaExplanation: Training methods হলো শেখানোর উপায়, যেমন presentations, demonstration, role plays।
Demonstration-এর পর practical sessions দিন, যাতে learners নিজে করে feedback পায়।
Coaching হলো task oriented আর performance driven।
Mentoring হলো relationship oriented আর development driven, দুটো গুলিয়ে ফেলবেন না।

example.bn: Coaching = নির্দিষ্ট কাজ শেখানো; mentoring = মানুষটির সার্বিক উন্নতি।
example.en: A senior electrician coaches a trainee to wire a switchboard. Over months, he also mentors her growth.

short.modelAnswer:
Three training methods:
1. Presentations: present information to small or large groups.
2. Demonstration: show learners a task or skill step by step.
3. Role-plays: simulate real work, followed by debriefing.
Coaching is task oriented and performance driven. Mentoring is a developmental partnership. It is relationship oriented and development driven.

viva.prompt: What is the difference between coaching and mentoring?

realQuestions.answer:
•
Presentation/discussion - most common and popular method of training
usually delivered as a speech by the teacher or instructor before the class or
students as a method of instruction
•
Demonstration - a display given to students by the teacher on how something
is done or how something works
•
Role Play - acting out of part: the acting out of a part, especially that of
somebody with a particular social role, in order to understand the role or
person better This process is used in psychotherapy and in training people in
interpersonal skills.
Difference between coaching and mentoring
Coaching is a process that enables learning and development to occur and thus
performance to improve. Coaching is task oriented and it is performance driven.
Mentoring is the developmental partnership through which one person shares
knowledge, skills, information and perspective to foster the personal and professional
growth of someone else. Mentoring is relationship oriented and development driven.
